## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `hk check --all` passes
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test (or the description says why it can't)
- [ ] Docs, values, or an ADR are updated if behavior or configuration changed
- [ ] No private keys, passwords, or enrolled certificates are committed
